title: 第十六章 剑器舞第十七章 杀人的雾
content_zh:
走出金刀门，萧无恨来到街市上，看着路上熙熙攘攘的人群，似乎也感受到了春天的气息，几个小孩正在拿着会转的风车奔跑，其中一个还留着鼻涕；一个小孩正在缠着大人要买纸糊的风筝，闪闪的眼睛里充满了祈求的眼神，大人们则又好气有好笑，看着这明媚的阳光，算了吧，还是给孩子们买吧……
此刻，萧无恨想起了温暖的家，想起了那如画的江南，又想到了叶苍柏那苍老的脸，心中暗道：“父亲，今天我放过了一个仇人，也不知是对是错，但愿你的在天之灵给我一些启示。”想起了那个小孩，萧心情轻松了一些，然后他又想到了空中划出的十几个变招，心中暗道：“这绝代一剑的变化真是高深莫测，那一剑出去之后竟不受自己的控制，原来我并未完全明白这一剑真正的潜力！”想着、想着，萧无恨的肚子便饿了，他走进一家酒店，叫了一碗阳春面，一碟牛肉和一壶酒。
一会之后，面和牛肉都来了。萧无恨端过牛肉，贪婪的闻了一闻，心道：“好香！”原来这几个月来，他每顿饭只是一碗白面。他自小家里发生巨变之后，便受尽苦难，人间疾苦早已习以为常，再加上身上没有多少银子，所以生活地非常简朴，一碟牛肉已是萧无恨最大的奢侈！他倒出第一杯酒，而后洒在地上，默默地祭奠死去的亲人。之后再倒上第二杯酒，一饮而尽，一股浓烈的酒香直上喉头。
这时旁边的一桌客人忽然道：“这位朋友，何不过来共饮几杯？”
萧无恨转头一看，好一位俊雅的公子坐在那里，目若凝波，面如冠玉，不带一丝人间烟火之气，旁边坐着一位书童打扮的少年，也是唇红齿白，十分清秀。那儒雅公子微笑看着他，举杯示意，但萧无恨却冷冷回了一句：“我没有朋友！”
那书童一看萧无恨回绝，便白了他一眼，道：“有什么了不起，平时你想请我们，还请不到呢！”说完便嘟着嘴，甚是可爱。那位公子忙使眼神，阻止书童的进一步牢骚。
这边，一位三绺清须的中年文士看到了一切，端起一杯酒道；“四海之内皆兄弟，喝一杯酒有什么打紧，我来敬这位兄弟一杯！”说完把酒敬了那俊雅公子一杯。
那位公子道声“多谢”把酒喝下后，中年文士又倒上一杯酒，站起身形对店内所有的客人道：“各位，有缘千里相会，无缘对面不识，杨某敬大家一杯！”但见店内的客人叫声好，一起干了一杯酒，这时又有一位商人模样的人对店家叫道：“小二，今天的酒钱全算我的头上，各位吃好喝好！”众人一听又叫声好，气氛更加热烈。只有萧无恨默默地吃着面，仿佛一切都与他无甚关系。那位锦衣公子本有心和他相交，见如此只好作罢。
萧无恨吃完了最后一口面，掏出钱来放在桌上准备离去。这时，店内忽然进来六七个人，其中一位瘦面鼠须之人对着喝酒的的中年文士道：“杨兄好雅兴啊，在这里躲着喝酒，却叫兄弟们好找啊！”
那中年文士脸色一变，道：“姜老哥真是阴魂不散，非要苦苦相逼吗？”
瘦面鼠须之人道：“少罗嗦，今天你不把东西交出来，休想活着离开。”说完便抽出了一柄短刀。
店内的其它客人一看情况不妙，纷纷逃离现场，生怕祸及自个。顷刻间只剩下三桌人在那里，一座是那位公子和他的书童，另一座是刚才请客喝酒的商人，旁边站着一位大汉，一身横练精肉，估计是他的保镖。还有一个人就是萧无恨，他本已打算走了，但此刻又坐了下来。
那姓杨的中年文士冷笑道：“姓姜的话别说早了，我杨某这三尺青锋，还没有把你放在眼里。”
姓姜的道：“嘿嘿，我姜某你是不放在眼里，难道血影门你也不放在眼里吗，这件事上头已经委托了血影门，我身后这两位便是‘金钩双煞’两位大哥，识相的乖乖地把东西叫出来，我姜某给你求个情，你还有条活路！”
但听血影门的名字一报，店内的人除了萧无恨以外，脸色皆是大变。原来血影门乃江湖中最隐秘的一个杀手组织，专门负责替人暗杀行刺、绑架勒索等，虽然价钱极贵，但是由于手段毒辣高明，所以江湖中有许多豪门和帮派都和其有过往来，许多轰动一时的大案便是血影门犯下的，其门主“风雪影“更是神秘莫测，江湖中人恨不能食其肉，寝其皮，却又无可奈何。
中年文士拔出剑道：“既然如此，杨某今天就领教各位的高招了！”
金钩双煞中的青煞走出，冷笑一声道：“对付你，我一个就够了，想死还不容易！”说完把兵器一亮便如疾风一般，扑向中年文士。
中年文士连忙把剑一抖，只见寒影森森，几朵剑花凌空刺向青煞，青煞在空中转身闪过，然后右手挥出一道寒芒，钩向中年文士的颈部。中年文士见状回手一剑挡住金钩，然后顺势一削，滑向青煞的手腕，青煞连忙后退一步躲过了这一剑，这一退竟输了一招。
那边旁观的黑煞见状道：“看来还低估你这号人物了，兄弟并肩子上！”说完两人左一划，右一划，卷起阵阵寒风划向中年文士。
这边站在商人旁边的大汉见状，不禁大怒，正要出手相帮，那商人却按住了他，道：“慢着，先看情况。”

content_en:
After walking out of the Golden Knife Gate, Xiao Wuhen came to the street market. Looking at the bustling crowds on the road, he seemed to feel the breath of spring. Several children were running with a spinning windmill, one of them still had a runny nose; a child was pestering an adult to buy a paper kite, his sparkling eyes full of pleading. The adults were angry and funny. Looking at the bright sunshine, forget it, let's buy it for the children...
At this moment, Xiao Wuhen thought of his warm home, the picturesque Jiangnan, and Ye Cangbai's old face, and thought to himself: "Father, I let go of an enemy today. I don't know whether it was right or wrong. I hope your spirit in heaven can give me some enlightenment." Thinking of the child, Xiao felt a little more relaxed, and then he thought of Kong. He drew more than a dozen tricks and thought to himself: "The changes of this peerless sword are really unpredictable. After the sword went out, it was out of my control. It turns out that I didn't fully understand the true potential of this sword!" Thinking about it, Xiao Wuhen became hungry. He walked into a hotel and ordered a bowl of Yangchun noodles, a plate of beef and a bottle of wine.
After a while, the noodles and beef came. Xiao Wuhen took the beef, smelled it greedily, and said to himself: "It smells so good!" It turned out that for the past few months, he had only had a bowl of white noodles for every meal. He has suffered a lot since the great changes in his family since he was young. He has long been accustomed to suffering in the world. In addition, he does not have much money, so he lives a very simple life. A plate of beef is Xiao Wuhen's greatest luxury! He poured out the first glass of wine, then sprinkled it on the ground, silently paying homage to his dead relatives. Then he poured a second glass of wine and drank it down. A strong aroma of wine went straight up his throat.
At this time, a guest at the table next to me suddenly said: "My friend, why don't you come over and have a few drinks together?"
Xiao Wuhen turned around and saw a handsome and elegant young man sitting there. His eyes were as clear as ice and his face was like a crown of jade. There was no trace of human fireworks. Sitting next to him was a young man dressed as a bookboy. He also had red lips and white teeth, and was very delicate. The elegant young man looked at him with a smile and raised his glass, but Xiao Wuhen replied coldly: "I have no friends!"
When the book boy saw Xiao Wuhen's refusal, he rolled his eyes at him and said, "What's the big deal? You usually want to invite us, but you can't!" After saying that, he pouted, looking very cute. The young man made a quick look to stop the book boy from complaining further.
Here, a middle-aged scribe with a clear beard in three locks saw everything. He picked up a glass of wine and said, "We are all brothers in the four seas. It doesn't matter if we drink a glass of wine. Let me toast this brother!" After that, he gave the wine to the handsome young master.
After the young man said "Thank you" and drank the wine, the middle-aged scribe poured another glass of wine, stood up and said to all the guests in the store: "Everyone, we are destined to meet each other thousands of miles away, but not across from each other by chance. Yang Mou toasts everyone!" The guests shouted "Hello" and drank a glass of wine together. At this time, another man who looked like a businessman shouted to the store: "Waiter, all the money for today's wine is on my head. Enjoy your meal and drink!" When everyone heard this, they shouted "Hello" again, and the atmosphere became more lively. Only Xiao Wuhen ate the noodles silently, as if everything had nothing to do with him. The young man in brocade had originally intended to have a relationship with him, but when he saw this, he had no choice but to give up.
Xiao Wuhen finished his last bite of noodles, took out his money and put it on the table to leave. At this time, six or seven people suddenly came into the store. One of them, a man with a thin face and a ratty beard, said to the middle-aged scribe who was drinking: "Brother Yang is so elegant. He is hiding here to drink, but it is easy to find the brothers!"
The middle-aged scribe's expression changed and he said, "Brother Jiang is really haunted. Do you have to force me to do this?"
The thin-faced and rat-bearded man said: "You're so wordy, if you don't hand over your things today, you won't be able to leave alive." After saying that, he pulled out a short knife.
Other customers in the store saw that the situation was not good and fled the scene one after another for fear of harming themselves. Suddenly there were only three tables leftThere were people there, one was the young master and his book boy, and the other was the businessman who had just invited them to drink. Next to them stood a big man with a muscular body, who was probably his bodyguard. There was another person named Xiao Wuhen. He had planned to leave, but now he sat down again.
The middle-aged scribe surnamed Yang sneered: "Don't say it too soon, surnamed Jiang. I, Yang, am a tall young man, and I haven't taken you seriously yet."
The man surnamed Jiang said: "Hey, you don't take me seriously, Jiang. Don't you take the Blood Shadow Sect too seriously? The Blood Shadow Sect has been entrusted with this matter. The two men behind me are the two big brothers of the 'Golden Hook Shuangsha'. Please call the things out obediently. I, Jiang, will beg you a favor. You still have a way to survive!"
But upon hearing the name of the Blood Shadow Sect, the expressions of everyone in the store changed drastically except for Xiao Wuhen. It turns out that the Blood Shadow Sect is the most secretive killer organization in the world, specializing in assassinations, kidnappings, and extortion. Although it is extremely expensive, due to its vicious and sophisticated methods, many wealthy families and gangs in the world have had dealings with it. Many of the most sensational crimes were committed by the Blood Shadow Sect. Its leader "Feng Xueying" is even more mysterious. People in the world want to eat its flesh and sleep on its skin, but there is nothing they can do.
The middle-aged scribe drew his sword and said: "In that case, Yang will learn your clever tricks today!"
The Qing Sha among the two evil spirits with golden hooks walked out and sneered: "I can deal with you by myself. It's not easy to die!" After saying that, he flashed his weapon and rushed towards the middle-aged scribe like a gust of wind.
The middle-aged scribe hurriedly shook his sword, only to see a cold shadow, and several sword flowers stabbed Qingsha in the air. Qingsha turned and flashed in the air, and then swung a cold light with his right hand, hooking towards the neck of the middle-aged scribe. Seeing this, the middle-aged scribe turned back and blocked the golden hook with his sword, and then slashed it towards Qingsha's wrist. Qingsha quickly took a step back to avoid the sword, but this move actually resulted in the loss of a move.
Hei Sha, who was watching over there, saw this and said: "It seems that I have underestimated you as a person. Let's go shoulder to shoulder, brothers!" After saying that, the two of them swung left and right, whipping up gusts of cold wind and rowing towards the middle-aged scribe.
The big man standing next to the businessman was furious when he saw this. He was about to help, but the businessman held him down and said, "Wait a minute, let's see the situation first."
